club_head_speed_mph.note: 350 yd-class total in the repo flight model needs ~130 mph (smash 1.48, ~13 deg, ~2100 rpm -> 351 yd); Bryson video-AI avg 128 mph (not radar); tour avg 113 (TrackMan).

ball_speed_mph.note: Foresight: 190 mph ball -> 342-372 yd carry, 378-401 total (optimistic vendor table); repo model: 192 mph -> ~351 total.

smash_factor.note: Tour avg 1.48 (PDF) / 1.49 (blog). Physics cap for center hit: (1+e)/(1+m_ball/m_head) = 1.83/1.23 = 1.49 with e=0.83, 200 g head; CT limit bounds e. The cap is why speed, not smash, must scale.

launch_angle_deg.note: Foresight optimum 10-14 deg at 190 mph ball speed; tour avg 10.9 deg at 167 mph.

spin_rate_rpm.note: Foresight optimum 1600-2600 rpm at 190 mph ball speed; tour avg 2686 (PDF) / 2545 (blog).

carry_yd.note: Repo model carry 321-325 yd at 130 mph; Foresight 342-372 (vendor, optimistic). Wind/altitude/turf not modeled.

total_distance_yd.note: Repo model: 348-353 at 130 mph club; 391-399 at 150. ODS test (317 yd) assumes only 120 mph/10 deg/2520 rpm.

attack_angle_deg.note: Positive attack angle is standard long-drive advice; no verified published tour-driver value fetched (TrackMan tour avg is -1.3 deg).

pelvis_peak_speed_dps.note: Pros 477 (Cheetham); Bryson 506 (Sportsbox, 51st pct of tour); tour range 440-543 (Sportsbox); max 590 in Bourgain sample.

club_shaft_peak_speed_dps.note: Pros 2254 at 109 mph head speed (Cheetham); Bryson shaft 2495 (Sportsbox); tour range 2054-2356. Upper bound is extrapolation.

hand_peak_speed_dps.note: Hand 945 (Neal 2007 as cited by Edwards 2022) vs 1650+-211 (Bourgain, range 1300-2100): different definitions (linear vs resultant).

wrist_hinge_uncock_peak_speed_dps.note: No verified isolated wrist-uncock rate fetched. Proxy: arm->club speed gain 1274 deg/s (Cheetham pros, 109 mph) scaled by v: ~1520 deg/s at 130 mph (derived, low).

seq_peak_time_before_impact_ms.note: Pros, driver. Lags: pelvis->thorax 19 ms, thorax->arm 3 ms (timing differences between pros and amateurs not significant; amateurs' SDs >=2x). Speed gains pelvis->thorax 250, thorax->arm 253, arm->club 1274 deg/s.

peak_vertical_grf_bw.note: Driver/5-iron vertical peak 1.6-2.0 BW; AP 0.4-0.6; ML 0.2-0.3 (Hume 2005, from search snippet of the PDF). Likely lower than a 130+ mph swing's needs: extrapolation unverified.

ground_reaction_torque_nm.note: Han 2019 shows lead-foot GRF moment (F/B axis) and trail-foot pivoting moment (vertical axis) correlate with clubhead speed, but N*m magnitudes were not retrieved.

club_length_in.note: 48 in. hard limit (verified, fetched). Tour/long-drive typical lengths NOT verified. Optional Local Rule G-10 caps at 46 in. Longer than 48 only with documented need and Local Committee approval (R&A).

driver_head_mass_g.note: ~200 g is the repo assumption (also model XML); no rule limit on head mass; published driver mass not verified here.

characteristic_time_us.note: CT limit 239 us + 18 us test tolerance (search snippet of USGA notice).

head_volume_cc.note: 460 cc max is widely stated; only a retail guide surfaced in search - USGA page not fetched.

ladder.note: Mason's stated club speed (self-reported, unverified): ~320-327 yd total in model; consistent with his 300+ yd claim.
~350 yd total in model: the '350-class' threshold; ~Bryson avg club speed per Sportsbox video-AI.
~370-377 yd in model; beyond any verified tour average (extrapolation).
~391-399 yd in model; at/above Bryson's claimed peak (Arccos); unverified, injury-risk regime.

mason_gap.note: Self-reported (+3 hcp, 120+ mph, 300+ yd), not independently measured; repo video data cannot measure club speed. A launch monitor session is the first step.

assumptions: Wrist uncock rate = Cheetham arm->club gain (1274 deg/s at 109 mph) scaled linearly with head speed (derived, low confidence).

Nesbit & Serrano (n=4, one swing each, scratch golfer 52.0 m/s = 116 mph): peak club power 3875 W, angular power 1150 W, total body work 1452 J, club KE 334 J; scaled by v^3 (power) and v^2 (work/energy) - extrapolation.

Motor model: MuJoCo <motor> is torque-only (no speed-torque curve); joint damping is a passive loss, so net torque at rate w is tau_max - b*w; no-load speed tau_max/b; max mechanical power tau_max^2/(4b).
XML defines no joint velocity limit; 'joint speed' limits here are damping-implied only.
findings: right_wrist: tau_max 60 N*m but damping 2.0 N*m*s/rad gives no-load speed 30 rad/s (1719 deg/s) and max power 450 W; at the ~130 mph wrist rate (~26.5 rad/s) only ~12% of torque remains. Needs damping <=~1.1 (50% margin) or tau >=~106 N*m, or both.
right_wrist max power 450 W vs Nesbit-scaled angular power ~1.6 kW at 130 mph: ~3.6x short on wrist power alone.

chest_yaw: range +-45 deg (90 deg total) vs real shoulder turn ~94-112 deg back + follow-through (Sportsbox tour range 94-106, Bryson 112); only yaw DOF (no pelvis yaw, so no pelvis/thorax separation or X-factor 59-68 deg). 120 N*m / 3.6 kW is adequate for thorax speed 950 deg/s (16.6 rad/s, drag 17 N*m).
Hip actuators are pitch (sagittal) only: they cannot produce the pelvis rotation (440-590 deg/s) that carries the sequence; ground-reaction torque about the vertical axis is not controllable.
Model club: head 0.20 kg, shaft 0.10 kg, 1.12 m -> inertia about wrist 0.291 kg*m^2; real club length limit 48 in = 1.219 m (model 1.12 m ~ 44 in. to head centre).

caveats: Single-view ~30 fps video cannot verify any of these; the profile is a literature-based prior only.
Repo flight model: center-face, no wind, simplified roll; it under-predicts TrackMan tour-avg carry by ~2.5% (268 vs 275 yd).

Overspeed/injury: L4-L5 compression 6.5-8+ BW after impact (Edwards 2022); higher club speed associated with back injury in a small PGA case-control (association only); no injury-outcome trials of overspeed protocols were found.
Rule status: 48 in. max length; 460 cc, CT 239 us and ODS tests bound equipment; USGA 2028 ball test (125 mph/11 deg/2220 rpm) will trim ~13-15 yd for the longest hitters (USGA FAQ).
